digest.component_or_area: host updater script and launchd runtime management
propositions: The host updater script uses unlocked pipx VCS installation, which bypasses the committed uv.lock and Click security override, allowing incompatible eval+dev dependencies to be resolved.

The updater must be refactored to check out exact SHAs from git ls-remote and run uv sync --locked with deterministic extras (mcp, reviewbot, ui, agents, eval, tracing, grounding, grounding-t2) instead of pipx VCS resolution.
Sync or smoke-test failures must be logged, rejected candidates removed, current state preserved atomically, and only the published release retained after successful build.

The published runtime must report Click 8.4.2 and pass pip-audit with no PYSEC-2026-2132 vulnerability, with rebar and rebar-mcp stable links resolving through current into the versioned exact-SHA release.
Launchd-triggered updates must advance last-good.sha to the installed SHA, exit cleanly on success, and log no-op on immediate re-run when already on the same SHA.
